_note: The salary that house rent allowance is measured against (D-092; rulebook SAL-DEF-HRA-001, H-4). TY 2026-27: Income-tax Rules, 2026 r.279(2)(b) (gazette p.1776): "'salary' includes dearness allowance, if provided for under the terms of employment, but excludes all other allowances and perquisites." No commission in the text. TY 2025-26: Income-tax Rules, 1962 r.2A Explanation (i): "'salary' shall have the meaning assigned to it in clause (h) of rule 2 of Part A of the Fourth Schedule" (DoR compendium pp.347-348; also indiankanoon.org/doc/154865060) — and Income-tax Act, 1961, Fourth Schedule Part A r.2(h) (thc.nic.in copy, current to Act 7 of 2019, p.853): "'salary' includes dearness allowance, if the terms of employment so provide, but excludes all other allowances and perquisites." The compendium's annotations to r.2A cite Gestetner Duplicators v. CIT [1979] 117 ITR 1 (SC): commission on sales paid under the contract of employment is 'salary' — which components count is the registry's (W-064), not this row's.

provision1961.reference: r.2A Explanation (i), with Income-tax Act, 1961 Sch. IV Pt A r.2(h)

introducedBy.instrumentCitation: Income-tax (Fourth Amendment) Rules, 1986 — the latest change to rule 2A of the Income-tax Rules, 1962 found (clause (c) substituted, clause (d) and Explanation (iii) omitted; Explanation (i) unchanged since rule 2A's insertion in 1965)

provenance.sourceDescription: Income-tax Rules, 1962 r.2A as in the Department of Revenue compendium (Taxmann, current to 2010-11) pp.347-348, with S.O. 412(E) dated 9-7-1986 per the CBDT notification record; Income-tax Act, 1961 Sch. IV Pt A r.2(h) on thc.nic.in p.853
provenance.whatToCheck: Any amendment to Income-tax Rules, 1962 rule 2A (and to Sch. IV Pt A r.2(h) of the Act) after 2011 up to AY 2026-27: the compendium read is current only to 2010-11. Confirm Explanation (i) still refers to Sch. IV Pt A r.2(h).
